rv.q: Laurence Connor’s production (one of countless revivals over the years) was first seen in 2019, with Jason Donovan here reprising his role as the Pharaoh and Alexandra Burke replacing Sheridan Smith as the narrator. No one could argue, either, that Joseph – rather scrappy, definitely silly – rates as one of Lloyd Webber’s most accomplished shows.
The show is still a winner that lives up to the daft excess of its title.
Laurence Connor's buoyant revival of Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice's Biblical musical charmed audiences back in 2019, and remains an absolute winner.
